related: negative regulation of sphingolipid biosynthesis involved in cellular sphingolipid homeostasis

definition: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency or extent of sphingolipid biosynthesis. Sphingolipid biosynthesis is the chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of sphingolipids, any of a class of lipids containing the long-chain amine diol sphingosine or a closely related base (a sphingoid).
label: negative regulation of sphingolipid biosynthetic process
